Evidence / output: Discover: define readers, questions, harm, source permissions and the manual-search baseline.
Scope: choose a small corpus, answer boundaries, access rules and freshness requirements.
Prepare: clean/extract documents, inspect tables, attach metadata and declare 20 evaluation questions.
Build: configure a grounded workspace or implement retrieval with visible passage references.
Evaluate: inspect retrieval and answer support separately, including conflicts, unknowns and forbidden access.
Release: obtain corpus and application approval and expose only to the named audience.
Operate: replace one source, refresh retrieval and rerun affected tests; observe permitted feedback seven days.
Hand over: document ownership, update/deletion process, access changes, costs and shutdown.
